cues.text: Welcome to the ultimate World of Wonders!
It looks suspiciously green. Where are the magic buttons?
Buttons? This place runs on pure adventure, Teddy!
Adventure doesn't pay for my snacks. Is there a food stand?
Look at the big trees! Let us climb high!
Wait for me!
Uff, my paws are shaking!
Mmm, this mango is out of this world!
Oops! I dropped a stone instead of a mango!
My stomach is louder than a train engine. Let us fish!
Quiet! You will scare every fish in the water!
Ha! A giant blue fish just bit my toe!
Pull it up! That is a massive catch!
Oof! It pulled me into the river instead!
Swimming lessons starting now, Teddy!
The water is freezing cold! Save my tail!
Look at the rainbow over the waterfall! So pretty!
Pretty doesn't dry my fur. Where is a towel?
Boom! Instant campfire for drying up!
Ah, wonderful. Now I can feel my toes again.
Look at these glowing mushrooms near the bank!
Do not eat glowing things! They might turn us into frogs!
Ribbit ribbit! Too late, I am already a frog!
What?! Stop joking around before I faint!
Shh! Look at the wild deer drinking by the pond!
Wow, they have majestic horns. Can we ride one?
Absolutely not! They are wild animals, not ponies!
I will offer them a cookie. Deer love cookies!
You are going to get us chased by a deer!
Run! The deer took my entire cookie jar!
Stop running, you will trip on a root!
Phew! We lost the deer. That was close!
Look down there! A wooden bridge over the river!
It is swaying like a hammock in a hurricane!
Walk fast and keep your balance! We can do it!
Whoa! My shoe almost fell into the water!
Gotcha! Never let go of my hand!
You saved my life, Peddy. You are a true hero!
{look:crystal_tower} Behold! The grand Crystal Tower of Wonders!
It looks like a giant sparkling ice-cream cone!
Let us go inside and find the secret treasure!
I smell something sweet. Is there a bakery in there?
Only one way to find out. Follow me!
You go first! What if there is a dragon?
Dragons only exist in fairy tales, silly!
Fine, but I am holding your backpack the whole time!
Look at all the floating stars in the air!
They are actually glowing candies! I am dreaming!
Taste one! It tastes like sweet strawberry!
Oh wow! I can literally float in the air now!
See? I told you this is the World of Wonders!
Wheee! I am flying higher than a bird!
Let us fly all the way to the moon together!
Best adventure ever! Let us stay forever!
The sun is setting behind the hills now.
And my tummy is making funny roaring sounds.
Time to rest by the campfire and count the stars.
Good thing I saved one marshmallow for dessert!
You always think about food, Teddy!
Food is the eighth wonder of the world, Peddy!
Agreed. What a crazy, wonderful day this was!
Goodbye, World of Wonders! Until next time!
